episodes.186257: Scattered showers and isolated thunderstorms moved rapidly east across parts of southeast Arizona during the afternoon.  One thunderstorm produce severe wind gusts in Safford.
episodes.186281: An upper low that stalled offshore the California coast injected inland as an open short wave trough and brought an increased chance for showers to the Sierra and Western Nevada. A subsequently stronger, more dynamic, upper shortwave and attendant cold front dropped south and southwest into the region and brought enhanced, more organized bands of shower activity, lower snow-levels, and breezy south-southwest winds. This resulted in some  travel impacts to higher Sierra passes.

events.narrative: A mesonet station (GPEN2-Washoe City) located 3.0 mi NE of Mount Rose Ski Base, NV, reported a rainfall storm total of 0.55 inches.
A mesonet station (GRZC1) located 4.6 mi NE of Cromberg, CA, reported a rainfall storm total of 0.94 inches.
A mesonet station (LCHN-Sheldon NWR) located 13.0 mi W of Catnip Mountain, NV, reported a rainfall storm total of 0.82 inches.

A CoCoRahs station (CA-NV-51) located 1.6 mi N of Truckee, CA, reported a rainfall storm total of 0.59 inches, as well as 0.5 inches of snow. A mesonet station (DNRC1) located 1.9 mi NE of Donner Peak, CA, and a local official located at the Central Sierra Snow Lab, CA, reported rainfall storm totals of 1.12 inches and 2.20 respectively.

A mesonet station (FW7537-Fallen Leaf) located 4.0 mi WNW of Meyers, CA, a mesonet station (RWBC1-Baron) located 1 WSW of Meyers, CA, and a mesonet station (EW3758) located 1.0 mi NNE of Meyers, CA, reported rainfall storm totals of 1.11 inches, 0.93 inches, and 0.67 inches respectively.
A thunderstorm wind gust to 61 mph was recorded at the KSAD Safford Municipal Airport at 1523MST.
